text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~ The zoo~! When was the last time I 
came here? I don't even remember~
choice_data_list: The crowd isn't too bad.
The crowd isn't too bad.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right~ This looks like we can really take 
it easy. I need to thank Fine-chan once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The reason being, Fine Motion was 
handing these tickets out to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, they received it through their 
involvement with bringing animals to the 
area, and shared it, saying, "Feel free to 
use this for a break."
choice_data_list:
(Alright, time to kick back and take a 
real break~!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Trainer-san is covered in rabbits~. 
How are you feeling right now~?
choice_data_list: I'm so soothed~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, inspiration struck! I might be 
able to use this idea for training with 
Hishi Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? Hehe! I have nooo idea what you're 
talking about~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*, this forest corner is so 
calming... There's a table too, so maybe a 
quick nap~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yawning in sync with her, I jot down the 
inspiration I got from the rabbit into my 
notebook.
choice_data_list: (To reduce the strain from bunny hops...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good day! How is your break go— ...Wait, 
oh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Sorry for peeking! I was just 
wondering what you were writing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know! Have you checked out the 
cat plaza over there? It'd definitely be a 
nice change of pace――
choice_data_list:
It's okay, I'm making sure to take breaks 
too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that what happened?
choice_data_list:
Go at your own pace and in a way that 
suits you.

Go at your own pace and in a way that 
suits you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I realized it during our 'healing 
training.' Trying to 'force myself to 
relax' just isn't for me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So today, while finding comfort in the 
rabbits and other animals... I was still 
thinking about work. This is what suits me 
best, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, I've been covered in 
bunnies and even courted by a gorilla! 
Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—I see. Ehehe, then that's great♪ Make 
sure to make lots of fun memories, okay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was so fulfilling—so, normally 
it'd be time to head home... but~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, my special "healing spot"... would you 
like to go there with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her special "relaxation spot" lay tucked 
away, reachable only after transferring 
buses.
choice_data_list: What a beautiful place~
What a beautiful place, isn't it~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~? I especially love this 
spot at this time of day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her lead, I close my eyes. The 
rhythmic sound of the waves ebbing and 
flowing... Listening to it, a thought 
suddenly crossed my mind.
choice_data_list: It kinda reminds me of you.
It kind of reminds me of you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
The way the pace never changes is just 
like the waves.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You think so~? Still... Ufufu, I see, I 
see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. What you did just now made me 
sooo happy!"
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It's what you told Fine-chan at the zoo. 
The whole 'at your own pace' thing."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I was so happy... and just as relieved~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—I think everyone has a pace that suits 
them best, you know~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe moving to an upbeat tempo suits me 
better~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe moving in a calm, measured way suits 
you better.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I've never been very good with being 
rushed or hurried since I was little."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Like, what you 'should' do, or what goals 
you 'should' aim for... I get it, but it's 
kinda like, hmm? Doesn't it tire you out 
when the pace is all off?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The same goes for 'how to unwind.' If it 
doesn't match a person's pace, it'll just 
tire them out."
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those words bring back memories. Of a time 
when I didn't yet know the right way to 
'unwind' for myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason I felt so mentally exhausted 
trying so hard to rest was surely because 
the 'pace' wasn't right for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So I was just like, whew, what a relief~~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Being able to find a "pace" that fits 
Trainer together with them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Good job, me~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, by the way, when I said "maybe around 
this pace," that was purely a gut feeling. 
Not that it's anything impressive, though.
choice_data_list: It IS a big deal!!!
That's a wonderful talent.
My trainer really is excellent, huh.

My Trainer really is outstanding, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, by the way, when I said "maybe around 
this pace," that was purely a gut feeling. 
Not that it's anything impressive, though.
choice_data_list: It IS a big deal!!!
That's a wonderful talent.
My trainer really is excellent, huh.

My Trainer really is outstanding, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you startled me~. Jeez, Trainer, you 
always go all out every single time.
choice_data_list: T-That's true...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah, she's always exaggerating like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Still, this is fine. No—this is what's 
best for me.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Talent, huh. I think I definitely have a 
talent for slacking off, though.
choice_data_list: That's a talent in its own right, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're complimenting everything, 
aren't you? Honestly, the same goes for 
you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You really have a knack for flattering 
people into high spirits, don't you? Quite 
troublesome, really~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're still keeping that up~? I'm telling 
you, you don't need my training anymore.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And so, you've mastered the art. From now 
on, you can slack off with me... Or 
rather, take it easy and unwind with me, 
okay~?
